images.filename: West Virginia National Guard - Flickr - The National Guard (11).jpg
images.caption: Soldiers of the West Virginia Army National Guard assigned to 821st Engineering Company from Summersville, W.Va., assist in debris and snow cleanup in Nicholas County.  The estimated two feet of snow caused havoc throughout the county, but especially on many of the windy mountainous roads, where existing erosion combined with heavy, wet snow to cause land slides and fallen trees. (Army photo by Staff Sgt. Debra Richardson)
images.alt: Soldiers of the West Virginia Army National Guard assigned to 821st Engineering Company from Summersville, W.Va., assist in debris and snow cleanup in Nicholas County.  The estimated two feet of snow caused havoc throughout the county, but especially on many of the windy mountainous roads, where existing erosion combined with heavy, wet snow to cause land slides and fallen trees. (Army photo by Staff Sgt. Debra Richardson)
